description: Publish draft to live. handoff required; feedback optional. Warnings (form_unwired, store, SEO) are advisory — tell the user. Site-check errors return a publish_issues decision: tell the user; to publish anyway, call again with publishWithIssues = its code.

acknowledgeSeoWarnings.description: Only satisfies the brief seo=must block, never publish_issues.

confirmedDraftFingerprint.description: Required when get_draft_status returned requiredDecision (publish_confirm). Must match the current draft fingerprint from get_draft_status.

feedback.description: Optional session feedback; tool intents are attached automatically.

category.description: missing_tool | blocking_error | extra_round_trips | confusing_response | workaround | other

handoff.description: One sentence: decisions, preferences, or open threads for the next session (appended to the brief).

onlyReady.description: Publish only changes marked ready (server hashes). Incompatible with pages. Skips publish_confirm fingerprint when set.

pages.description: Publish only these pages — use when a publish returns rules_not_fully_checked; publish the rest in further batches (≤50 route paths, e.g. /pricing).

publishWithIssues.description: Code from a publish_issues decision, only after the user agreed to publish with those errors. true does not work.

name: publish_site
